title: Treatise on the Qi-Carrying Edge
summary: Teaches a student with steady qi how to load the jian's edge and release it in long cuts and thrusts.

title: The Jian Guard and Answer
summary: Joins a firm guard with an immediate answering cut so a defending student never loses the exchange.

title: Lessons in Binding the Opposing Blade
summary: Trains a guarded student to lock and break the opposing sword in contact with the slender blade.

title: Handbook of the Sword Wave
summary: Shows how to throw a thin crescent of qi from the jian's edge at a distant opponent.

title: Complete Course of the Slender Sword
summary: Gives a broad full course of cuts and thrusts and parries and paces for the jian with the first qi-bearing forms.

title: Spiral and Thread Forms
summary: Teaches corkscrewing thrusts and woven guards that make the most of the blade's slenderness.

title: The Coiling Point Method
summary: Draws the sword arm back like a spring and releases it in quick pairs of thrusts.

title: A Study of Distance and Timing
summary: Studies measure of reach and the rhythm of exchanges so that a jian student chooses the moment to strike.

title: Reading the Opponent's Blade
summary: Teaches a guarded student to read an opposing blade and its qi before the cut begins.

title: The Flying Tassel Forms
summary: Uses the swinging pommel tassel to veil and misdirect the jian's cuts and thrusts.
